# model.config.FmriLmConfig { #fmrimod.model.config.FmriLmConfig }

```python
FmriLmConfig(
    robust=RobustOptions(),
    ar=AROptions(),
    volume_weights=VolumeWeightOptions(),
    soft_subspace=SoftSubspaceOptions(),
    solver='auto',
    na_action='error',
)
```

Complete configuration for GLM fitting.

Collects all sub-option groups into one object, analogous to R's
``fmri_lm_control()``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                          | Default                 |
|----------------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| robust         | RobustOptions              | Robust fitting options.                                                                                                                              | `RobustOptions()`       |
| ar             | AROptions                  | AR noise modelling options.                                                                                                                          | `AROptions()`           |
| volume_weights | VolumeWeightOptions        | Volume weighting options.                                                                                                                            | `VolumeWeightOptions()` |
| soft_subspace  | SoftSubspaceOptions        | Soft subspace projection options.                                                                                                                    | `SoftSubspaceOptions()` |
| solver         | (\'auto\', \'pinv\')       | Projection solver for OLS. ``"auto"`` keeps the fast default path; ``"pinv"`` uses a Moore-Penrose projection for strict reference parity workflows. | `"auto"`                |
| na_action      | (\'error\', \'propagate\') | Response-data non-finite policy. ``"error"`` fails before fitting; ``"propagate"`` lets affected voxels surface NaN coefficients.                    | `"error"`               |
